latest.title: Big community arrest programme didn't change survival
latest.finding: Survival to discharge with good neurological outcome 9.0% (intervention) vs 9.4% (usual care), adjusted OR 0.97, 95% CI 0.75–1.26, P = 0.80

latest.title: Prehospital Extracorporeal Life Support
latest.finding: Survival to discharge 40% with ECPR vs 20% without (OR 2.72, 95% CI 1.59–4.66); favourable neurological outcome at 6 months 36% vs 13% (OR 4.22, 95% CI 2.82–6.32); 32 adverse events with ECPR vs 11

latest.title: Intubation linked to more ROSC in OHCA registry
latest.finding: ROSC 21.1% with intubation vs 3.8% with basic airway (multivariable OR 7.61, propensity-matched OR 6.33); the unadjusted association was not significant in the shockable-rhythm stratum
